methodologyNotes: Twelve countertop water distillers were verified 2026-08-05 primarily against manufacturer/brand-store pages (waterwise.com, h2olabs.com, megahomedistiller.com, mypurewater.com, durastillwatersystems.com, rovsun.com, cozpalace.com, vevor.fr) and corroborating retailer/manual listings (nutriteam.com, drinkgear.co.uk, thewaterdistillerstore.com, manualslib.com), with Amazon/Walmart product pages largely inaccessible to automated fetch (bot-wall/CAPTCHA or JS-only rendering) so US Amazon pricing could not be confirmed for three entries (VEVOR, OLizee, Mophorn) — priceUsd is left null for those with the best located reference price (EUR/GBP or unconfirmed) recorded in priceNote rather than guessed.

products.name: Megahome MH-943TWS Countertop Water Distiller, White with Glass Collection Bottle
products.priceNote: Current price at nutriteam.com (authorized Megahome dealer); megahomestore.com (manufacturer's own storefront) was unreachable during research (connection refused)

specs.storage_tank_capacity: 1 gal (4L) glass collection bottle with porcelain nozzle insert
specs.material: 304 stainless steel boil chamber, dome, and cooling coils; water only contacts stainless steel and glass

products.provenance: Nutriteam's dealer listing (reproducing Megahome's own product copy) documents the 1 gal/5.5 hr output, 580W/120V rating, glass collection bottle, activated-charcoal sachet filter (25-day replacement interval), and UL listing. Megahome's official instruction manual (hosted on ManualsLib, model MH-943TWS/SBS/SWS shared manual) independently confirms the #304 stainless steel boiler/dome/coil construction and PP collection bottle, plus a 6.0 kg gross shipping weight for the full kit (7.7 lb unit-only weight taken from the nutriteam listing). Megahome's own store domain (megahomestore.com) returned a connection error on every fetch attempt during this research session, so pricing relies on the nutriteam dealer page.

specs.cycle_time: ~3.5-4 hours to process a full 1.1 gal (4L) batch at 0.3 gal/hr (1L/hr)

products.provenance: CO-Z's own brand storefront (cozpalace.com) documents 750W rated power, 1.1 gal (4L) capacity, a 0.3 gal/hr (1L/hr) distillation rate yielding water rated at 2 ppm, a 304 stainless steel interior with a BPA-free plastic collection pitcher, thermal auto shutoff (activates at 300F or on low water), included cleaning powder, FDA/CE certification, and dimensions/weights for both the distiller body and separate collection pot. CO-Z's product documentation separately confirms activated-carbon packs at the water outlet (VOC/odor removal, recommended replacement every 3-6 months) -- this base model is distinct from CO-Z's higher-wattage 1750W dual-temperature-display variant also sold under the same 1.1-gallon capacity.

products.provenance: Durastill's own manufacturer page states an 8 gal/day (30L) production rate from a 1.5 gal (6L) 316-alloy stainless steel evaporator with an Incoloy heating element, 1100W at 10A on a standard 120V/60Hz outlet, automatic shutoff as the boiler nears empty, an included carbon post-filter with installation kit, 60 dB operating noise, dimensions 23 in. A third-party dealer (thewaterdistillerstore.com) independently listed a 1000W/9A heating element and smaller 13x20x13 in. footprint for the same model number -- the manufacturer's own published figures (1100W, 23x16x18 in.) are used as authoritative. This is a continuous manual-fill unit (push-button activation, no built-in storage reservoir) rather than a discrete-batch distiller, so production_rate_gal_per_cycle is left null.

specs.cycle_time: ~4 hours per 1.1 gal (4L) batch at 0.3 gal/hr (1L/hr)
specs.storage_tank_capacity: 1.1 gal (4L); glass carafe or plastic (PBT) container depending on variant

products.provenance: VEVOR's own brand storefront (accessed via its .fr regional storefront after the .com domain repeatedly geo-redirected during this research session) documents a 750W heating element producing up to 0.3 gal (1L) per hour / ~6 gal (24L) per day from a 4L (1.1 gal) capacity, food-grade stainless steel interior construction, automatic shutoff protection, and a digital display with temperature/timing controls; variants are sold with either a glass carafe or a plastic (PBT) collection container. Dimensions and weight were not stated on the fetched regional pages and could not be confirmed on the geo-blocked US site, so both are left null. Multiple US retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Lowe's per search results) carry this model but returned bot-wall/CAPTCHA or JS-only responses that prevented confirming US pricing directly.
